cohort: Foetuses diagnosed with Persistent Right Umbilical Vein (PRUV) out of 10,743 screened foetuses.
finding: The incidence of intrahepatic PRUV was 0.11% (12 of 10,743 foetuses), with 50% having additional abnormal sonographic findings and 33.3% having major congenital malformations, predominantly congenital heart disease.
gest_age: Between 20 and 35 weeks at the time of diagnosis.
